title: I-have-ADHD: A skill to stop coding agents from burying the answer
why_read: A niche tool/prompt-engineering hack addressing a real annoyance with coding agents burying important output, useful for practitioners building on LLM coding assistants.
analysis: This appears to be a 'skill' or prompt pattern designed to stop AI coding agents from hiding the actual answer at the end of long verbose responses, a common frustration when working with LLM-based coding tools. The high comment count suggests it triggered debate about whether such fixes are genuine solutions or superficial workarounds for deeper agent design problems. It's a practical, narrow contribution rather than a research breakthrough, useful for engineers actively using coding agents day to day.
